_: Official X (Twitter) post that announces each version's Special Program / Special Broadcast.
_why: A nitter timeline only reaches back a few days, but the card is re-rendered for the whole 6-week version and every `mode=test` run starts from an empty state. So the tweet id is discovered once from the timeline and kept here — fxtwitter still serves a 5-week-old tweet by id, which is what makes the link and the key art correct on a test run.
_updated_by: .github/workflows/monitor.yml commits this file back when a new announcement is found (same pattern as posted_tweets.json in the X monitor repo).
_verified: Every id below was resolved through https://api.fxtwitter.com/status/<id> on 2026-09-27 and returned the key art at ?name=orig.
